headlines.title: Multiple dead, including gunman, following shooting at Bend, Oregon elementary school
headlines.description: Multiple people are dead, including the gunman, after a shooting at a Bend, Oregon elementary school, according to four senior law enforcement officials briefed on the preliminary investigation. NBC News' Tom Winter reports.

headlines.title: Feds investigate suspicious letters sent to lawmakers and election officials
headlines.description: More than a dozen election offices in states across the country were sent letters with suspicious materials.

headlines.title: Send your questions for Steve Kornacki on the midterms
headlines.description: With less than three weeks before Election Day, Steve Kornacki is ready to answer your questions on all things midterms.

headlines.title: Kevin Warsh speech could offer clues on whether Fed will raise interest rates this month
headlines.description: Two inflation reports this week set the stage for a rate hike potentially sooner than previously expected.

headlines.title: ICE agent driving vehicle that struck and injured Houston man is placed on administrative leave
headlines.description: The Harris County DA has interviewed a key witness who was in the ICE vehicle when it hit Miguel Parra Hernandez.

headlines.title: Trump says execution of Fort Hood shooter will not be livestreamed
headlines.description: President Trump announced that the firing squad execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan will not be livestreamed, overriding Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth’s earlier claim that it would be. NBC News' Monica Alba reports the latest details from the White House.

headlines.title: Cornell president faces contentious faculty senate meeting over Jane Doe allegations
headlines.description: Cornell University’s president was met with scrutiny and sharp questions from its faculty senate Wednesday, when the group convened to discuss a no-confidence vote over the university’s handling of an alleged 2024 sexual assault at a fraternity house, according to an audio recording obtained by NBC News.

headlines.title: Cracks are beginning to show in the stock market as doubts about AI investments grow
headlines.description: Consumers already face a host of stressors. If AI spending and tech stocks show signs of sustained decline, U.S. economic growth could be at risk.

headlines.title: Four years after discovery, remains found in a barrel in Lake Mead identified as those of 1980s murder victim
headlines.description: The bones with remnants of clothing were found in a deteriorated drum in 2022 as the waters of Lake Mead in Nevada receded. Who killed Edward Lelburian Jackson is still unknown.

headlines.title: Trump invokes executive privilege in Kennedy Center court fight
headlines.description: A White House lawyer said information about the president’s management of the center, including efforts to add his name to it, should be off-limits.

headlines.title: Why AOC was in a deep-red part of Michigan: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez’s campaign swing with Michigan Democratic Senate nominee Abdul El-Sayed today was about much more than boosting him on Election Day in November.
